body:
I'm struggling to find fixes for the "🐧 Linux / Editor with doubles and GCC sanitizers (target=editor, dev_build=yes, scu_build=yes, precision=double, use_asan=yes, use_ubsan=yes, linker=mold)" test job. As the last few commits to this PR show, the memory leaks at least seem to be subtle, assuming they even are related to my committed changes.

I've tested each of the last two commits with Docker Desktop to try to simulate the job before submitting changes, but they do not show memory leaks (but they have shown some of the divide-by-zero or out-of-bounds-indices errors).

At this point, I don't even understand if my changes are actually causing the errors. To confirm this, I am considering redoing this PR with a clean fork from Godot, then simply copy-pasting my changes to test_image.cpp into said fork.

Before I do this, are there any other things I should try?
